original_card.first_experiment: Choose one assumption ID (native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery), one quantified implication and exact dependency closure. actual_scope: Exact extremal table and minimum charge of the relaxed literal actual-reader model on the h-hub star of PR4145, for every hub count h >= 1 over any field of characteristic zero.
scope_change_reason: Open Next Question 1 of unpaidmoon's PR4145 (research/p112-third-hub-extremal), on the same uniform-transfer-audit card, asks whether the excess 4h(h+1) is exact for every h; that package proves equality only for h <= 3. This package answers that question. It is a side result about one finite row model, not a caller-bound all-size implication.
bottleneck_link: Side result. The actual-reader pair floor is one retained complex-side tariff relaxation; this fixes its exact growth in the hub count. It does not change any supplier bill or kappa.
stop_rule: Stop once the extremal table, the cost-one witnesses and the closed-form charge are proved for every h, with a census control through h=5. Do not attempt characteristic two.
